This is a graph-guard: a typed knowledge graph layered behind a RAG retriever, letting multi-hop questions get answered via graph traversal instead of pure similarity, with a measured comparison against the heavier RDF/OWL/SHACL/SPARQL semantic stack.

Main entry points:
- `graph_guard/` — the core package
- `examples/run_sample.py` — runnable demo, no API key needed
- `eval/` — evaluation harness (measured +14% hit@10, +26% MRR on multi-hop)
- `docs/` — documentation

Setup: `pip install -e . && python examples/run_sample.py`

Tests: `pytest` (137 tests, 97% coverage)
